verdict.rationale: Phoenix ships a built-in AI agent (Phoenix Intelligence) and a prompt playground, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows only the reverse role: Phoenix exposes its own `/mcp` endpoint for external clients like Claude Code and Cursor, and that server-side capability does not transfer to this client story. Nothing in the pack shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Phoenix so it can use their tools.
